title: A Asset for the Debt
author: Felix Montrose
blurb: Freya Halloran, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
